title: Range Doppler Response
text: Range-Doppler response, 4 inputs, 3 outputs, {Doppler output} sets Doppler output; {Measurement mode}, {Range processing method}, {Propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Inherit sample rate}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sampling rate, {Reference range (m)}, {Source of pulse repetition frequency}, {Pulse repetition frequency of the input signal (Hz)}, {Source of FFT length in Doppler processing}, {FFT length in Doppler processing}, {Doppler processing window}, {Doppler sidelobe attenuation level}, {Signal carrier frequency (Hz)} sets the signal carrier frequency 3e8, {FM sweep slope (Hz/s)} sets the fM sweep slope 1e9, {Dechirp input signal}, {Source of FFT length in range processing}, {FFT length in range processing}, {Range processing window}, {Set reference range at center}, {Range sidelobe attenuation level} and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
